statement: Tier list of party dungeon RNG items is based on progression not farming and aimed at the general 99% not the 1% giga chads
Angel light revives you once without losing RNG items and gives +20% drop rate but only really matters in world one; not great
Armadillo gives +1 base damage and 10 max HP; not strong unless going a hard health build; B tier
Battery makes ability cooldowns 25% faster; nice but needs a really high manifold to use properly; B tier
Pig belly makes food heal 20% more and drops two food items; works in any dungeon and is insane in world 2 dungeons; god tier
Blood vial gives +2 damage per missing health up to 30%; hard to keep low health at high rank but useful; not F tier
Boss skull increases damage vs bosses scaling to 44% at max level; would be god tier if it hit giant monsters too so A tier
Can of varnish (rusty blade) gives 30% more base damage plus a rusty blade; decent but only base damage not total; B tier
Dead book gives 0.5% damage and crit chance per monster type defeated; initially said only useful with horn of the full
Decaf latte increases skilling speed; useless in world one but super good in world 2 and 3; B tier
Decaf latte is what helps win getting the third snake; without it going for third snake you're usually boned
Fashion sense (25% higher equipment rarity) is the worst garbage item; you'd choose anything over it; F tier
Genesis sphere has 18.5% chance to drop a new grey RNG item up to 60% with RNG voucher; godlike for voucher build; prioritize it
Golden dice has very low chance of working; utility for farming not progression; C tier
Grey grumble gives +40% damage with all RNG items grey; great beginner build but ruins over half the RNG items and makes you reliant on runs; A tier
Handy ice pick gives 25% chance for an additional line of damage; easy double damage; god tier
Helping heart gives +2 max HP; okay and picked only when nothing else is available; C tier
Horn of the full is easy god tier despite jokes that it is trash
Liar's craps gives -15 drop rate and -15 max HP; you take many other items over it; C tier
MP crystal is common and better than health because mana is needed for abilities and higher MP regenerates mana faster; A tier
Muscle memory gives 0.5 damage per skilling action up to 50; damage but not crazy; C tier
Ninja smoke gives 1.5 seconds invincibility after being hit; sucks; F tier
Pen lid increases block chance by 2% and is claimed op for completing things; A tier
Plump dice gives chance of extra loot dice based on HP at the end; same as the money die; C tier
Rabbit's paw is a flat drop rate increase; between C and B so placed B
Recycler has 5% chance to drop an additional RNG item; insane with genesis sphere; A tier
RNG voucher gives 10% chance to drop an RNG item when selling an enhancer; only item that gets you out of grey grumble build; god tier
RNG voucher can give high damage but breaks runs
Rusty blade is damage but not great; more important to maestro main than barbarians or squires; unbiased B tier
Sandals give movement speed; C tier
Sharpie gives 3% crit chance up to 6% at max level and is the staple to make horn of the full good; A tier
Shattered mirror gives 25% chance to recast abilities free of mana; insane on squire and barbarian and nasty on wizard; strong A tier
Single cut costs 10 damage then gives +6% damage and +2% per level up to about 9%; 90% chance to drop again; stackable percent damage; A tier
Sneaky cap gives 2% crit per minute undamaged up to 30%; nerfed since maps no longer last 10 minutes; C tier
Spare change drops cash every 30 seconds while standing still and carries over; free money; B tier
Spiky spine deals 120 damage to monsters that hit you and crits on block; good pickup but B tier
Stone of the bulwark gives -85% attack speed and mana regen but +25 block and 300 damage; worst RNG item needing a rework; F tier
Dead book ranking vetoed and moved to B tier after discussion
Sucker punch increases crit damage by 25%; only useful with crit chance; B tier
Stardew drop gives 50% damage if MP is full; speaker admits bias but keeps it god tier
Sugar rush increases attack speed and is the staple to win games; god tier
Tax ledger gives 8% more cash from monsters for NPC shops; niche; C tier
Thorny rose gives +10 max HP but you take 6 damage; uncommon and meh; F tier
Tortoise shell gives +0.1 block chance per hit up to 5; B tier for block build but mostly C tier
Transmogrifier box (lose all single grey RNG items and get new ones) could be great or worst; circumstance dependent; B tier
Unbalanced scale makes sellable items worth 20% more; B tier
Vampire fangs give 50% chance to heal 1 HP on kill; not reliable; C tier
God tier: RNG voucher; pig belly; genesis sphere; handy ice pick; horn of the full; stardew drop; sugar rush; always take these
A tier: boss skull; grey grumble; mana crystal; pen lid; recycler; shop eye?; shattered mirror; single cut; chosen over many others
B tier middle of pack: armadillo; battery; can of varnish; decaf latte; rabbit's paw; rusty blade; spare change; spiky spine; dead book; sucker punch; transmogrifier box; unbalanced scale
C tier: angel light; blood vial; golden dice; plump dice; helping heart; liar's craps; muscle memory; sandals; sneaky cap; tax ledger; tortoise shell; vampire fangs; niche
Golden dice and plump dice are for farming not progression but not terrible to take
F tier: ninja smoke; fashion sense; stone of the bulwark; thorny rose (said bloody rose); don't take these and leave them on the ground
